title: The Bloop: The Mysterious Low-Frequency Sound
place: The Pacific Ocean, off the coast of Chile

scenes.text: Located in the Pacific Ocean, off the coast of Chile
The Bloop is a low-frequency sound that is louder than any known earthly sound, and was detected by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) in 1997
A diagram of the NOAA's Equatorial Pacific Ocean autonomous hydrophone array

description: The Bloop is a mysterious low-frequency sound that was detected in 1997. What could be the source of this sound? Follow us for more ocean mysteries.
